steps.name: Environment setup and global persistence
steps.description: Verify Node >=16, ensure npm/yarn available on PATH, compute sanitized global bin paths (npm prefix + /bin, yarn bin if present), write an idempotent /etc/profile.d/react_env.sh that only sets CI, BROWSER, and NODE_ENV when unset and prepends deterministic PATH entries. Use atomic write (temp + compare) to avoid stomping existing file. Source the updated profile for this run and print versions to validate PATH.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/an-infinite-canvas-unpainted-12-89/ObjectStorage"
# validate node/npm presence and Node >=16
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "node not found" >&2; exit 2; }
NODE_V_RAW=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || true)
NODE_V_NUM=${NODE_V_RAW#v}
NODE_MAJOR=${NODE_V_NUM%%.*}
if ! [[ "$NODE_MAJOR" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 16 ]; then
  echo "node major version $NODE_V_NUM is unsupported; require >=16" >&2; exit 3
fi
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "npm not found" >&2; exit 4; }
# derive sanitized npm global bin from npm config prefix
NPM_PREFIX=$(npm config get prefix 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -n "$NPM_PREFIX" ]; then NPM_GLOBAL_BIN="$NPM_PREFIX/bin"; else NPM_GLOBAL_BIN=""; fi
# derive yarn bin dir if yarn exists
YARN_BIN=""
if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  YARN_BIN=$(dirname "$(command -v yarn)") || YARN_BIN=""
fi
NODE_BIN_DIR=$(dirname "$(command -v node)")
# build PATH entries (only include non-empty unique entries)
PATH_ENTRIES=()
[ -n "$NODE_BIN_DIR" ] && PATH_ENTRIES+=("$NODE_BIN_DIR")
[ -n "$NPM_GLOBAL_BIN" ] && PATH_ENTRIES+=("$NPM_GLOBAL_BIN")
[ -n "$YARN_BIN" ] && PATH_ENTRIES+=("$YARN_BIN")
# prepare profile content guarded to only set vars if unset
PROFILE_TMP=$(mktemp)
cat > "$PROFILE_TMP" <<'EOF'
# React headless CI environment (auto-generated). Safe to source.
# Only set defaults when the variables are not already defined by users.
: "__PLACEHOLDER__" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
if [ -z "${CI:-}" ]; then export CI=true; fi
if [ -z "${BROWSER:-}" ]; then export BROWSER=none; fi
if [ -z "${NODE_ENV:-}" ]; then export NODE_ENV=development; fi
# prepend workspace and tool bins; preserve user PATH on source
export PATH="__PATH_PREFIX__:$PATH"
EOF
# replace placeholders with computed values
# assemble prefix
PREFIX="$(IFS=:; echo "${PATH_ENTRIES[*]}")"
# include workspace node_modules/.bin
PREFIX="$PREFIX:$WS/node_modules/.bin"
sed -e "s#__PLACEHOLDER__##g" -e "s#__PATH_PREFIX__#${PREFIX}#g" -i "$PROFILE_TMP"
# atomically write only if changed
TARGET=/etc/profile.d/react_env.sh
sudo bash -c "cmp -s '$PROFILE_TMP' '$TARGET' >/dev/null 2>&1 || cp '$PROFILE_TMP' '$TARGET'"
sudo chmod 644 "$TARGET"
rm -f "$PROFILE_TMP"
# source for this run (non-login shells)
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source /etc/profile.d/react_env.sh || true
# verify CLI versions visible on PATH
node -v >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "node not visible on PATH after profile load" >&2; exit 5; }
npm -v >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npm not visible on PATH after profile load" >&2; exit 6; }
# print versions for debugging (minimal output)
echo "node:${NODE_V_RAW:-unknown} npm:$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) yarn:$(command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1 && yarn -v || echo none)"

steps.name: Install project dependencies (generate lockfile if missing)
steps.description: Install project dependencies non-interactively. If a lockfile exists use npm ci or yarn --frozen-lockfile. If no lockfile exists, generate a proper package-lock.json with `npm install --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund` (non-destructive) unless ALLOW_UNPINNED_INSTALL=true. After lockfile present, run deterministic install and verify local ./node_modules/.bin/react-scripts exists and print version info.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/an-infinite-canvas-unpainted-12-89/ObjectStorage"
cd "$WS"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo 'package.json missing; run scaffold first' >&2; exit 2; }
USE_YARN=0
if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then USE_YARN=1; fi
# If no lockfile, create one deterministically using npm (package-lock-only) unless override
if [ $USE_YARN -eq 1 ]; then
  if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
    yarn install --silent --frozen-lockfile || { echo 'yarn --frozen-lockfile failed' >&2; exit 3; }
  else
    if [ "${ALLOW_UNPINNED_INSTALL:-false}" != "true" ]; then
      # generate yarn.lock by running yarn install --silent but do not modify package.json
      yarn install --silent || { echo 'yarn install to generate yarn.lock failed' >&2; exit 4; }
      yarn install --silent --frozen-lockfile || { echo 'yarn --frozen-lockfile failed post-lock generation' >&2; exit 5; }
    else
      yarn install --silent || { echo 'yarn install failed' >&2; exit 6; }
    fi
  fi
else
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
    npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo 'npm ci failed' >&2; exit 7; }
  else
    if [ "${ALLOW_UNPINNED_INSTALL:-false}" != "true" ]; then
      npm install --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo 'npm --package-lock-only failed' >&2; exit 8; }
      npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo 'npm ci failed after generating package-lock' >&2; exit 9; }
    else
      npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo 'npm install failed' >&2; exit 10; }
    fi
  fi
fi
# verify local react-scripts binary
if [ ! -x ./node_modules/.bin/react-scripts ]; then
  echo 'react-scripts not installed in node_modules; install may have failed' >&2; exit 11
fi
# print minimal versions for debugging
echo "node:$(node -v 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) npm:$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) yarn:$(command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1 && yarn -v || echo none)"
# try local react-scripts version
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/react-scripts ]; then
  ./node_modules/.bin/react-scripts --version 2>/dev/null || true
fi

steps.name: Validation: build, serve static build, verify and stop
steps.description: Build the project using local react-scripts and serve the produced build/ with python's http.server bound to 127.0.0.1. Select preferred port 3000 if free, otherwise find a free port by attempting to bind via Python. Health-check the server, capture HTTP status and a snippet of index.html, then shut down cleanly with a timed wait to avoid blocking.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/an-infinite-canvas-unpainted-12-89/ObjectStorage"
cd "$WS"
export CI=true
export BROWSER=none
# build using local binary when available
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/react-scripts ]; then
  ./node_modules/.bin/react-scripts build || { echo 'build failed' >&2; exit 7; }
else
  npm run build --silent || { echo 'build failed' >&2; exit 7; }
fi
BUILD_DIR="$WS/build"
[ -d "$BUILD_DIR" ] || { echo 'build directory missing' >&2; exit 8; }
# pick port: prefer 3000 if free, otherwise ask python to bind to 0 and print port
PREFERRED=3000
is_port_free_py() {
  python3 - <<PY 2>/dev/null || true
import socket,sys
s=socket.socket();
try:
 s.bind(('127.0.0.1', $1));
 s.close();
 print('free')
except Exception as e:
 print('busy')
PY
}
if [ "$(is_port_free_py)" = "free" ]; then PORT=$PREFERRED; else
  PORT=$(python3 - <<PY
import socket
s=socket.socket();s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));print(s.getsockname()[1]);s.close()
PY
)
fi
pushd "$BUILD_DIR" >/dev/null
python3 -m http.server "$PORT" --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/an-infinite-canvas-unpainted-12-89/ObjectStorage"
cd "$WS"
export CI=true
export BROWSER=none
# build using local binary when available
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/react-scripts ]; then
  ./node_modules/.bin/react-scripts build || { echo 'build failed' >&2; exit 7; }
else
  npm run build --silent || { echo 'build failed' >&2; exit 7; }
fi
BUILD_DIR="$WS/build"
[ -d "$BUILD_DIR" ] || { echo 'build directory missing' >&2; exit 8; }
# pick port: prefer 3000 if free, otherwise ask python to bind to 0 and print port
PREFERRED=3000
is_port_free_py() {
  python3 - <<PY 2>/dev/null || true
import socket,sys
s=socket.socket();
try:
 s.bind(('127.0.0.1', $1));
 s.close();
 print('free')
except Exception as e:
 print('busy')
PY
}
if [ "$(is_port_free_py)" = "free" ]; then PORT=$PREFERRED; else
  PORT=$(python3 - <<PY
import socket
s=socket.socket();s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));print(s.getsockname()[1]);s.close()
PY
)
fi
pushd "$BUILD_DIR" >/dev/null
python3 -m http.server "$PORT" --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
